ios.desc:
Yochaa equips you (an investor) with tools to simplify US and Nigerian Stock market data, and guides you to make informed investment decisions. 

Investment Assistant
Your personal Investment Assistant designed to help you make the most of investing opportunities.

Invest in US & Nigerian Stocks
- With as little as $2 you can invest in whole or fractional US stocks.
- Yochaa also gives you access to trade stocks listed on the Nigerian Stock Exchange.

We've partnered with CardinalStone Securities, a SEC registered broker-dealer and member of the Nigerian Stock Exchange to provide you with secure, speedy and seamless trading.

Yochaa Lounge 
- Yochaa Lounge gives you access to content-rich investment communities led by Financial experts and influencers.
- Join insightful, expert-led discussions for investment strategies you could copy or modify to suit your portfolio.
- Access stock charts directly from chat discussions.

Multiple Portfolio Trackers
- Monitor the performance of up to three stocks portfolio with regular price updates.
- Instant access to useful information on stocks you own: History of purchases, average cost price vs current market price, return on investment and percentage holdings.
- Create and monitor a dummy portfolio to understand the market before making real commitments.

Prices (With Charts)
- View price charts of all US & Nigerian stock market  securities over the last ten years.
- View performance of all Nigerian stock market securities at a glance.
-  Easily pick out the best and worst performers.
- Colour codes instantly show the state of the market on any day.

Explorer
- Cut out the noise and focus on only stocks you care about. Easily find stocks based on different performance indicators, index groups, NSE compliance status and more.

Insight
-  Regular research and analytics articles that would help guide and hopefully improve your investment decisions.

Note: We are constantly making updates to Yochaa. More features will be regularly added and published over the coming weeks. Thanks a lot for your patience.
